title: A stored BLANK in a one-side column and the blank row form a single BLANK group
query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( Product[Color], "Amount", [Sales Amount], "Products", COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( Product ) ) )

source.quote: The values obtained for the group-by columns include the blank values of invalid relationships
source.supports: the group-by values include the blank row

source.quote: If a relationship is invalid, the VertiPaq engine automatically adds a row containing BLANK in every column of the table on the one-side of the relationship
source.supports: the blank row has BLANK in its Color

source.quote: returns a table with the same columns and all the rows of the table (including duplicates) with the additional blank row caused by an invalid relationship if present
source.supports: VALUES of the table counts the blank row

derivation: Red is Bike: 100, 1 row. Blue is Lock: 30, 1 row. BLANK is both Bell (stored BLANK color, no sales) and the blank row (Sales rows 3 and 4: 50 + 20 = 70): one group, Amount 70, and VALUES ( Product ) has 2 rows there, Bell and the blank row.
